author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR003593 AAA+ ATPase domain

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
human SRPRA (P08240) and fly SrpRα (Q9U5L1)
human SRP54 (P61011) and fly Srp54k (Q9V3D9)



* **Description of issue**
These subunits of the signal recognition particle (SRP) are characterized as GTPases but are getting [ATP hydrolysis activity](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0016887) annotation via  IPR003593 AAA+ ATPase domain
title: IPR003593 AAA+ ATPase domain
